scope: retrospective frozen-score observability audit; no new alarm, model fit, raw HDF5 or GPU

fields: §63 protocol/result/seal and shots: ends, valid, dose, context, score

selection.reference: §65 per_shot 0.2.current_5; preparation shots 1-20 excluded from this diagnostic
selection.positive: §65 stored handoff u in (30,125] ms and nonzero §65 dose
selection.false_alarm_safe: §65 stored handoff u at or before original first false alarm, nonzero §65 dose
selection.never_alarm_safe: all §65 stored handoffs u with nonzero §65 dose from shots without an original alarm
selection.anchors: q is the last §63 probe index at or before u; q-32 is the earlier anchor; both require valid §63 inputs and positive §63 dose
selection.clock_note: q is no later than the verified handoff; q and q-32 can precede the positive 125 ms window; 32 is a sample offset, not a verified physical receipt delay
selection.selection_clock: q is selected retrospectively using the subsequently completed handoff u; each saved prefix score is causal, but this selection is not an online gate at q
selection.comparison: each safe group matched independently, all 33 positives jointly; max cardinality then minimum summed squared tolerance-normalized context distance over both anchors; one shot per side
selection.endpoint_tiebreak: for each shot pair choose minimum context distance, then earliest positive handoff, then earliest safe handoff; assignment rows/columns sorted by shot ID
selection.probe_selection: no probe score enters eligibility, matching cost, or tie-break
selection.sensitivity: remove each selected shot-pair edge in turn and recompute the same maximum-cardinality minimum-distance assignment; no alternative replaces the primary result
